project-token.description: API project token to retrieve your remote Codacy configuration for the project being analyzed

api-token.description: API account token to retrieve your remote Codacy configuration for the project being analyzed

coverage-reports.description: Optional comma separated list of coverage reports to send to Codacy

language.description: Optionally force associating a language with your coverage report

force-coverage-parser.description: Optionally force using a specific coverage report parser
